Generated Narrative: CodeSystem eu-ai-involvement-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-involvement-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
ai-generated AI GeneratedThe substantive content of the resource was generated by an AI system.
ai-assisted AI AssistedAn AI system supported a human author, while the human remained responsible for creating the substantive content.
ai-reported AI ReportedAn AI system transformed or reported existing information without independently asserting its clinical validity.
ai-asserted AI AssertedAn AI system asserted clinical or factual content as an output of its processing.
